hosting.//: COOP/COEP (cross-origin isolation) are deliberately NOT set here. The Pyodide runtime is single-threaded (no SharedArrayBuffer use anywhere in src/, loadPyodide requests no pthreads) and JSPI does not need isolation, so isolation buys nothing here -- and its COOP:same-origin severs window.opener, which the middleauth (CAVE) sign-in popup needs to save exports to GCS. Re-verify Pyodide 314 + JSPI still load un-isolated in target browsers if this is ever revisited.
hosting.//rewrites: The app moves itself to /v/pyodide/ at boot so share links look like /v/pyodide/#!{state}. Serve index.html for those (and any other) non-file paths so a pasted share link loads the app shell instead of 404ing.

headers.//: The /v/** paths are rewritten to index.html; match by request path so that shell is never cached (headers match the request, not the rewrite target).
